categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes P2P connection handling and private broadcast logic in src/net_processing.cpp and src/private_broadcast.cpp, and carries the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a privacy side channel in private transaction broadcast where adversaries returning a transaction early could suppress remaining outbound connections and correlate broadcasts. While privacy of transaction origin is a top priority in P2P, the author explicitly describes this as addressing a 'theoretical timing attack', making it strategically important rather than an urgent release blocker.

categories.name: tests

categories.rationale: Does not belong to test infrastructure because the test additions and updates pin the behavior of P2P private broadcast rather than framework or harness utilities.
